questions.stem: The books ______ to the library every Monday.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语The books与动词return之间是被动关系（书被归还），且时间状语every Monday表示经常性动作，应用一般现在时的被动语态am/is/are + 过去分词。主语是复数，所以用are returned。A是主动语态原形；C是过去式或过去分词，缺少be动词；D是现在进行时的主动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: —______ you ever ______ to the Science Museum? —Yes, I ______ there last weekend.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。第一句中有ever，询问"曾经是否去过"，用have been to表示"去过某地（已回）"；第二句中有明确的过去时间状语last weekend，需用一般过去时went。A选项第一空用了Did，但ever通常与现在完成时连用；C选项have gone to表示"去了某地（未回）"，与答句矛盾；D选项时态均不正确。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The story ______ is written by a 14-year-old student is very popular in our school.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句的关系代词。先行词是The story（物），在定语从句中作主语，应用which或that引导。A选项who用于指人；C选项whom用于指人且作宾语；D选项whose表示"...的"，在从句中作定语。解题技巧：指人用who/whom/that，指物用which/that， whose可指人也可指物。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: —Could you tell me ______? —Sure. Next Friday afternoon.
options: A. when we will have the English exam
B. when will we have the English exam
C. when do we have the English exam
D. when we have the English exam
questions.explanation: 本题考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除B和C；根据答句Next Friday afternoon（下周五下午），可知应用一般将来时will have，而D选项是一般现在时。解题技巧：宾语从句三要素——陈述语序、时态呼应、连接词选择。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: I'm very ______ to hear that you passed the driving test.
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。主语是人（I），表示"感到惊讶的"，用surprised；surprising表示"令人惊讶的"，通常修饰物。A是名词或动词原形；D是第三人称单数形式。固定搭配：be surprised to do sth. 惊讶地做某事。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The ______ news made everyone cry at the party.
questions.explanation: 本题考查前缀un-和词性转换。空格修饰名词news，需用形容词，排除C和D（副词）；根据句意"让大家哭泣"，可知是"不愉快的消息"，unhappy（不愉快的）符合语境。A选项happy（愉快的）与句意矛盾。技巧：un-是常见否定前缀，加在形容词前构成反义词。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to ______ the pollution problem before it's too late.
questions.explanation: 本题考查短语动词辨析。deal with表示"处理、对付"，与problem搭配合理；look after照顾；take off起飞/脱下；put away收起来。根据句意"处理污染问题"，选B。技巧：积累常见短语动词，注意与宾语的搭配。

questions.group_passage: Last month, our school started a new project called "Green Campus". The goal was to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment. Every class was asked to collect plastic bottles for recycling. At first, many students thought it was (8)______ to carry bottles to school every day. However, as time went by, they realized how much waste they could save. My class decided to do something different. We (9)______ to make art works from the collected bottles. Our teacher, Mr. Zhang, was very (10)______ about our idea. He said it was a creative way to reuse waste. We spent two weeks working on our project. Some students cut the bottles into different shapes, while others painted them colorful. Finally, we made a beautiful tree sculpture. It (11)______ in the school hall now. Every time I see it, I feel proud of what we have done. This project has taught us that small actions can make a big (12)______. If everyone tries to protect the environment, our world will become a better place to live.
questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。根据下文However（然而）表示转折，以及"他们意识到能节省多少浪费"，可推断起初学生觉得每天带瓶子很"无聊/烦人"，boring符合语境。B、C、D都是积极词汇，与However后的转变逻辑不符。

questions.group_passage:
When Bosco was in Grade 7, he noticed that his school wasted a lot of water in the bathroom. The taps were often left running after students washed their hands. This made him very worried.

With the help of his science teacher, Bosco started working on a solution. After six months of hard work, he finally invented a smart tap. This special tap can sense when hands are near and automatically turns on the water. When hands move away, it stops immediately.

"The device is simple but useful," says Bosco. "It can save about 30% of water compared to normal taps." Many schools in Shenzhen have shown interest in his invention. Some of them have already started using similar taps in their buildings.

Bosco's invention won the first prize in the city science competition last month. When asked about his future plans, he says, "I want to design more green products to help protect our environment. I believe that technology can make our life better and greener."

(Note: "device" means 装置; "automatically" means 自动地)
questions.stem: How long did Bosco spend working on the smart tap?
questions.explanation: 本题为细节理解题。根据文章第二段第二句"After six months of hard work, he finally invented a smart tap"可知，Bosco花了六个月时间研发这个智能水龙头。A、B、D选项的时间均与原文不符。解题技巧：细节题要找准关键词（how long对应时间），回原文定位具体信息。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

questions.group_passage:
Many students have trouble balancing their studies and hobbies. They often feel stressed because they don't have enough time for both. (17)______ Here are some useful tips.

First, make a weekly plan. Write down all your homework and after-school activities. (18)______ This way, you can see clearly how much free time you actually have.

Second, choose your hobbies wisely. You don't need to join every club at school. Pick one or two that you really enjoy. (19)______ Quality is more important than quantity.

(20)______ Even 30 minutes of reading or drawing every day can help you relax and learn better. Remember, hobbies are not a waste of time if they make you happy and creative.
options: A. Then, mark the time slots for studying.
B. However, this problem can be solved with good time management.
C. In addition, try to do a little bit of your hobby every day.
D. It's better to be good at one thing than to be average at many things.
E. On the other hand, studying is always more important than hobbies.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接。上文提到问题（无法平衡学习与爱好，感到压力），下文提出解决方法（Here are some useful tips），因此此处需要过渡句承上启下。B选项"然而，这个问题可以通过良好的时间管理解决"符合逻辑。A用于列举步骤；C用于递进；D用于解释；E用于转折对比。
